provenance: Replaces the broad R1-R13 seed rules in nyc.v1 with smaller rules verified against official NYC and New York State sources on 2026-07-22. Primary sources outrank authored scenario expectations. Official-source conflicts are preserved as conditional rules rather than resolved by guesswork. Unverified lead times and fees are excluded from verdict arithmetic.

status_legend.VERIFIED: confirmed against an official or primary source
status_legend.VERIFIED_WITH_QUALIFICATION: officially supported, but only with the qualifications encoded in the rule
status_legend.OFFICIAL_CONFLICT: current official sources conflict; boundary or deadline must remain conditional
status_legend.CONDITIONAL: the rule cannot produce a definitive conclusion without another fact or agency confirmation
status_legend.RESEARCH_REQUIRED: the requirement is identified, but an exact deadline, fee, portal, or implementation detail still requires primary-source confirmation
status_legend.COVERAGE_GAP: the ruleset does not evaluate this material event element

slack_warning_days.note: Internal planning buffer only. Never present this as an agency deadline.

business_day_math.note: Do not convert 15 business days to a fixed calendar-day approximation.

deadline_semantics.published_minimum: A published filing threshold or minimum notice period.
deadline_semantics.processing_range: An agency-reported processing range; not an approval guarantee.
deadline_semantics.recommended_buffer: A PopEngine or practitioner planning target, never an official deadline.
deadline_semantics.fixed_annual_date: A calendar deadline that is not calculated from the event date.
deadline_semantics.conditional: Excluded from verdict arithmetic until the missing fact is resolved.

engine_conventions: Conditions evaluate true, false, or unknown. Unknown material facts propagate to a CONDITIONAL result; they never silently evaluate false.
Only VERIFIED and VERIFIED_WITH_QUALIFICATION deadlines may affect published-deadline verdict arithmetic.
OFFICIAL_CONFLICT, CONDITIONAL, RESEARCH_REQUIRED, and COVERAGE_GAP rules are excluded from definitive deadline arithmetic.
A negative conclusion such as 'no new permit identified' requires all material trigger facts to be known.
Internal slack warnings are visually and semantically separate from agency filing deadlines.
Rules that share a dedupe_key merge into one plan item while preserving every triggering reason and source.
Historical plans retain their original ruleset version and source references.
Authoritative permit determinations are deterministic. AI-extracted inputs must be confirmed when material.

change_log.change: Bumped schema and ruleset from v1/nyc.v1 to v2/nyc.v2.
change_log.reason: The verified rules require threshold-specific inputs, official-conflict states, and actual business-day arithmetic.

change_log.change: Replaced universal SAPO ~60-day rule with class-specific Street Event, Plaza Event, Block Party, Production Event, and festival rules.
change_log.reason: Official deadlines range from 10 days to a prior-year fixed date.

change_log.change: Marked Single Block Festival deadline as OFFICIAL_CONFLICT.
change_log.reason: Current official CECM pages conflict between 90 days and December 31 of the preceding year.

change_log.change: Changed Parks threshold handling to >20 verified, exactly 20 conditional, and added small-group special-element rules.
change_log.reason: Current official Parks and NYC311 pages conflict at exactly 20 attendees.

change_log.change: Expanded NYPD sound rule to private property when sound is audible in adjacent public space and encoded per-device/multi-day fees.
change_log.reason: NYC Administrative Code §10-108 applies beyond property ownership alone.

change_log.change: Replaced generic food permit with vendor-permit and organizer-notification rules and removed the free-sampling exemption assumption.
change_log.reason: Public food service requires acceptable vendor permits whether food is sold or given away; organizers must notify DOHMH 30 days ahead.

change_log.change: Replaced any-generator rule with gasoline, diesel, battery, and >40 kW threshold rules.
change_log.reason: FDNY/DEP triggers are specification-dependent; no universal 45–60-day deadline was verified.

change_log.change: Replaced over-10x10 structure rule with official DOB area, height, compound-size, and duration thresholds.
change_log.reason: The verified tent threshold is more than 400 square feet, not more than 100 square feet.

change_log.change: Split fuel and open-flame permit categories.
change_log.reason: FDNY treats fuel use/storage separately from candles, sternos, and café heaters.

change_log.change: Added verified indoor/rooftop 75-person and outdoor 200-person assembly thresholds with TPA fee/deadline branches.
change_log.reason: Private venue use is not equivalent to no city requirements.

change_log.change: Replaced calendar approximation for SLA deadlines with actual 15-business-day calculations and exact fee formulas.
change_log.reason: One-Day and Catering Permit deadlines and fees are officially published.

change_log.change: Corrected SAPO insurance to include the block-party-without-a-ride exception and removed unverified universal additional-insured wording.
change_log.reason: CECM explicitly states the exception but current reviewed pages do not support one universal certificate wording.
